en: Vintage sepia postcard with two photographs. The top image shows a wooded hillside path or staircase leading up to a large building partially hidden by trees; a man in early 20th‑century clothing walks down the steps. The bottom image shows a pastoral scene with a field, grazing sheep, and a shepherd in the foreground, with a substantial multi‑storey hotel or villa set against dense woods in the background. Dutch captions identify the location as Hotel Koepel in Wester Meerwijk and mention the surroundings of Berg en Dal.
